title: Detailed pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <path d='M48,52 L18,14 Q14,9 18,7 Q22,5 25,9 L52,48 Z' fill='#C9D8E8'/>
  <path d='M48,52 L18,14 Q14,9 18,7 Q22,5 25,9 L52,48 Z' fill='none' stroke='#F0F6FF' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Blade edge highlight -->
  <path d='M50,49 L24,13' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <path d='M52,52 L82,14 Q86,9 82,7 Q78,5 75,9 L48,48 Z' fill='#B4C6DA'/>
  <path d='M52,52 L82,14 Q86,9 82,7 Q78,5 75,9 L48,48 Z' fill='none' stroke='#EAF2FC' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M50,49 L76,13' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='4.5' fill='#E8B33A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='4.5' fill='none' stroke='#FFE08A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='2' fill='#8A6414'/>
  <!-- Left handle ring -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#E04A4A' stroke-width='6.5'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#F58A8A' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='4 5'/>
  <!-- Right handle ring -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='74' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#3A7BD5' stroke-width='6.5'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='74' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#8FB8F0' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='4 5'/>
  <!-- Connectors from pivot to handles -->
  <path d='M45,57 L29,68' stroke='#E04A4A' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M55,57 L71,68' stroke='#3A7BD5' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
